stable.notes: Miles Windu's active one-, two-, three-, and four-plus-session stories now use the approved V15.1 strips with 16, 12, 13, and 16 frames. The transitions preserve droid positions, visible hits, the behind-the-back saber toss, and clean loop seams. Miles's idle portrait renders at pack-owned 2x scale while combat and global scaling remain unchanged inside the stable viewport. Elara Vale's V1.1 strips remove the oversized white matte around the green saber without changing its choreography. Exact stock Miles V15 and Elara V1 installs advance automatically; custom sprite packs are never overwritten. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
